seoTitle: HTML Head Extractor: Meta, Link and Title Table
metaDescription: List every title, meta, link and base element of a page head in one table and flag duplicates and missing basics. Free.
intro: Reads the head of pasted HTML and lists its elements with attributes.
why:
View-source mixes the head with everything else. A table of title, meta and link elements makes duplicate canonicals, double descriptions and missing viewport tags easy to see.

It reads text up to the closing head tag. It is not a full HTML parser, so very odd markup may be missed. Repeats that are allowed, like several og:image tags, are not flagged.
howTo: Fix flagged duplicates and add missing tags.

faq.a: More than one title, canonical, description, robots, viewport or similar single-use tag.

faq.q: Does it need a full page?
faq.a: No, a head block is enough.
